title: Why Everything Is a Subscription Now (And Who Really Wins)
alts: Subscriptions Explained: You Pay $133 a Month You Don't Notice
Subscription Economy Explained: Why Companies Want You Paying Monthly
line1: Why is everything a subscription now? People guess they pay $86 a month. The real number is $219. Here's why companies love it.
summary: Dave finds 11 subscriptions on his bank statement and only remembers 3. We explain why companies love recurring revenue and why investors value it higher, how cars, printers, software and streaming all went monthly, how free trials and dark patterns keep you paying, what happened to the FTC click-to-cancel rule, why prices creep up, and why gyms get paid by members who never go. Then Dave runs a subscription audit.
learn: Why recurring revenue makes companies worth more to investors
How heated seats, printer ink and software became subscriptions
How much people underestimate their subscription spending
